title: TableA1SummaryResponseTableA1ListResponse
description: A generic wrapper for list responses returned by the Blue Book API.

items.description: The list of items returned by the API.

version.description: The version number of this Table A-1 release (e.g., "16.0").

date.description: The release date of this version, and the date from which it is applicable for well data reporting.

TableA1SummaryResponse.description:
A lightweight summary of a Blue Book Table A-1 version, used when listing available versions
without returning the full dataset definitions.
